map.识别哪道工序的 FPY 最低，作为优先改进环节。: Identify which process has the lowest FPY as the priority improvement step.
map.RTY = FPY₁ × FPY₂ × … × FPYₙ，各 FPY 为各工序: RTY = FPY1 × FPY2 × … × FPYn, each FPY being each process's
map.（小数）。RTY 必 ≤ 任一单工序 FPY，工序越多、衰减越明显。: (decimal). RTY must be ≤ any single-process FPY; more processes means more obvious decay.
Three processes have first-pass yields of 98%, 97%, 99% respectively: RTY = 0.98 × 0.97 × 0.99 = 0.941094 ≈ 94.11% (decimal 0.9411). Even though each is close to 99%, after three in series the straight-through rate has fallen below 95%, indicating at least about 6% of units have undergone rework; the 97% process should be investigated.
map.RTY 和最终合格率差在哪？: Where does RTY differ from final yield?
map.最终合格率通常统计『最终合格品/投入品』，返修后合格也算合格；RTY 只算首次就: Final yield usually counts 'final good / input', counting units good after rework as good; RTY only counts those good all the way from the first pass, so RTY ≤ final yield, and the difference is the volume of rework waste.
map.工序越多 RTY 越低是必然吗？: Is RTY necessarily lower with more processes?
map.只要单工序 FPY<100% 就必然衰减，与工序数正相关；提升 RTY 要么提高: As long as a single-process FPY<100% there is inevitable decay, positively correlated with the number of processes; to raise RTY either improve the single-process FPY (root cause) or reduce unnecessary processes (slim down), not hide front-end defects by end screening.
map.RTY = y₁·y₂·y₃（y 为各工序良率）；例 98%×97%×99%≈9: RTY = y₁·y₂·y₃ (y is the yield of each process step); e.g. 98%×97%×99%≈94.11%. The more steps, the lower the RTY.
map.RTY = Π yᵢ（yᵢ 为各工序同口径一次通过率，小数）；例 98%×97%: RTY = Π yᵢ (yᵢ is each process first-pass yield on the same basis, decimal); example 98%×97%×99%≈94.11%. A 100% process does not reduce RTY; with more processes and any <100%, decay becomes more pronounced.
map.多工序串联的整体一次合格率。各输入须为同口径一次通过率（不含返修后合格）；可增删: Overall first-pass yield of processes in series. Each input must be a first-pass yield on the same basis (excluding reworked units); processes can be added or removed. Two distinct measures are shown: “equivalent geometric mean single-process defect rate” (back-calculated from RTY via the n-th root) and “arithmetic mean single-process defect rate”; do not mix them.
map.支持增删工序：新增 100% 工序不改变 RTY，新增 <100% 工序才继续衰: Processes can be added or removed: a new 100% process leaves RTY unchanged; only a new <100% process reduces it further.
map.区分「等效几何平均单工序不良率」与「算术平均单工序不良率」，避免把几何等效值误称: Distinguish the “equivalent geometric mean single-process defect rate” from the “arithmetic mean single-process defect rate”; do not call the geometric equivalent an arithmetic average.
map.RTY = FPY₁ × FPY₂ × … × FPYₙ（小数）。RTY ≤ 任: RTY = FPY₁ × FPY₂ × … × FPYₙ (decimal). RTY ≤ any single-process FPY. “Equivalent geometric mean single-process defect rate” = 1 − RTY^(1/n), back-calculated from RTY; “arithmetic mean single-process defect rate” = simple average of the individual defect rates. They are different and must not be mixed.
map.98%、97%、99%：RTY=0.98×0.97×0.99≈94.11%；等效: 98%, 97%, 99%: RTY=0.98×0.97×0.99≈94.11%; equivalent geometric mean defect rate≈2.00%; arithmetic mean=(2+3+1)/3≈2.00% (equal by coincidence here). Adding a 100% process leaves RTY at 94.11%, showing that a 100% process does not reduce RTY.
map.不是。新增 100% 工序不改变 RTY；只有新增工序的 FPY<100% 才会: No. Adding a 100% process does not change RTY; only a new process with FPY<100% reduces it further. Improve RTY by raising single-process FPY (root cause) or removing unnecessary processes (lean), not by end-of-line screening that hides upstream defects.
map.两种平均不良率该看哪个？: Which of the two average defect rates should I use?
map.「等效几何平均」回答的是：若各工序不良率相同，需要多高才能得到当前 RTY，适合: The “equivalent geometric mean” answers: if every process had the same defect rate, how high would it need to be to produce the current RTY; use it alongside RTY. The “arithmetic mean” is the simple average of the individual defect rates and describes the overall defect distribution. They share units but have different definitions; state which one is used.
map.等效几何平均单工序不良率 (%): Equivalent geometric mean single-process defect rate (%)
map.几何口径由 RTY 开 n 次方反推；算术口径为各工序不良率简单平均: Geometric measure is back-calculated from RTY via the n-th root; arithmetic measure is the simple average of individual defect rates
